scope: Read-only source/API assessment requested by the maintainer to avoid duplicating Caffeine's browser implementation.
missing_control_points: Public prepared manifest/bytes handoff before service admission and certificate issuance
Configurable gateway retry and concurrency policy
decision: Reuse upstream hashing, preparation and transfer. Keep narrow service/intent coordination. Prove the existing agent seam before proposing an additional certificate hook; prefer upstream support or a minimal pinned-package patch over a parallel SDK.
execution: Initial assessment inspected archive and source only. The subsequent local composition is recorded below; neither phase performed a paid call, deployment, upstream contact or sibling mutation.

local_composition.sdk: @icp-sdk/core 5.4.0, within the provider package's declared range; one SDK version in the fixture
local_composition.unmodified_package: Two Chromium/PocketIC scenarios passed in 4.49 seconds using the existing real HttpAgent constructor hook, with actual tree/chunk HTTP requests to an owned local substitute. No new certificate callback was needed.
local_composition.patch_scope: Static network-free preparation, immutable byte/manifest snapshot and single-use handle; per-client fetch/AbortSignal/retry/concurrency options. Provider hashes, chunks, certificate extraction and HTTP formats remain upstream-owned.
local_composition.patched_package: Four Chromium/PocketIC scenarios passed in 13.25 seconds: upload, lost reply/cancellation, failed tree request with no retry, and abort after the tree without chunk dispatch. The actual browser manifest passes bounded Rust conversion, tenant admission and uploader preparation before permission is returned; tenant-only preparation is refused. Caller byte mutation is isolated, copied/consumed handles and pre-issuance abort cannot dispatch. Earlier retained-intent/crypto checks remain.
local_composition.prepared_manifest_decoder: ops::caffeine::preparation reuses model metadata/root checks with explicit JSON and declaration limits; four native tests pass for accepted upstream metadata and malformed/oversized/inconsistent input. Redundant nested tree nodes are ignored, not independently validated. No file bytes or authority are accepted by the decoder.
local_composition.checks: Release storage Wasm and strict storage-test Clippy passed. Package source hashes checked before applying the patch to generated files; installed package unchanged. Browser checks are opt-in, not a full CI/release run.
local_composition.limits: Private fixture with test identity, two-slot IndexedDB, simulated service provider facts and owned HTTP gateway substitute. No deployed gateway or billing evidence, production consumer admission, durable gateway-effect journal or live retry authority. Package installation disabled scripts.

gateway_coordination.implementation: clients/browser/gateway.js wraps the existing patched fetch hook without changing the package patch, provider algorithms or wire formats.
gateway_coordination.intent: Caller-owned storage atomically retains request URL/method/headers/body size and SHA-256 fingerprint before fetch, bound to certificate intent and permanent cancellation. A retained execution token prevents recreated hooks or competing tabs from restarting an already claimed transfer.
gateway_coordination.observation: Complete bounded HTTP responses become historical status records before return to Caffeine. Network/body/observation-write failures retain uncertainty; non-2xx status blocks continuation. Neither HTTP success nor certificate recovery establishes provider completion or permits replay.
gateway_coordination.checks: Ten Chromium/PocketIC scenarios passed in 31.81 seconds, including claim/observation transaction aborts, held response/tab loss, oversized response, cancellation before claim and after dispatch, lifetime request capacity and refused continuation. Strict storage-test Clippy, release storage Wasm, JavaScript syntax, formatting and diff checks passed. No full CI/release gate ran.
gateway_coordination.limits: Two-slot IndexedDB fixture and owned local gateway substitute only. No production durability/eviction/backup guarantee, authenticated consumer integration, provider reconciliation, billing cessation or deployed qualification. No live provider effect or publication occurred.

signed_consumer_handoff.path: Signed browser ingress to the existing consumer probe retains asset intent and calls canonical admission as the actual tenant; the browser separately signs canonical manifest preparation as the uploader. The harness validates exact retained intent and replies before permitting certificate issuance.
signed_consumer_handoff.authority: Unrelated browser identity admission/preparation and direct uploader admission receive typed refusals. The IC SDK verifies update certificates against the owned PocketIC root. Rust supplies and validates opaque Candid from existing DTOs; JavaScript duplicates no service schema.
signed_consumer_handoff.checks: All ten Chromium/PocketIC scenarios pass in 50.58 seconds with this handoff. Strict storage-test Clippy, release storage/consumer Wasm, JavaScript syntax, formatting and diff checks pass. No full CI/release gate ran.
signed_consumer_handoff.limits: Existing consumer fixture uses its configured operator identity, not Toko membership policy. No production login, preparation journal, consumer API, provider completion or publication was added. Gateway/provider facts remain local substitutes.

consumer_followthrough.path: After gateway outcomes, signed browser calls attempt consumer registration. HTTP success leaves unconfirmed exposure unpublished. Cancelled cases persist consumer tombstones then withdraw the exact permission through the consumer's tenant client.
consumer_followthrough.checks: Ten Chromium/PocketIC scenarios pass in 45.53 seconds. Persisted consumer intent and revocation acknowledgments match; exposed reservations remain active/charged and browser journal history is unchanged. Common authorization refusal probes run once, while transport cases keep their individual recovery checks. Strict storage-test Clippy, release storage/consumer Wasm, JavaScript syntax, formatting and diff checks pass.
consumer_followthrough.limits: All consumer and provider behavior remains labelled local fixture evidence. No provider completion, production login/storage, deployment or publication was added; no full CI/release gate ran.
